concerns.quote: There appears to have been an inconsistency of approach following Miss [name redacted] admissions to A & E. She was referred directly to a Psychiatrist on the second attendance when she was clearly unwell but had not managed to self-harm but was not on the first attendance when she had taken an overdose. This also raises the question as to whether she ought to have been referred (to a Psychiatrist) on the 31° October 2012.
concerns.hazard: inconsistent referral of Miss Farah to psychiatry across A&E attendances
